name: Sparkly Rabbit and Fire Shroom
description: Adorable headband styled after Sparkly Rabbit and Fire Shroom.
story:
A popular product from Sparxie's livestream. According to some Sparxheads, it occasionally makes a "Mwah!" sound.

"Whoa, it even makes sounds! Sparxie really puts her heart into these!"
"Huh... Oh... So that's how it is... Hahaha!"

source.description: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
